name: Monk War Scholar (Rite Publishing)
body:
Combining intense academic analysis with lethal martial arts, the war scholar dissects enemy stances and strikes with geometric precision.

Analytical Strike (Ex)

A war scholar uses her Intelligence modifier in place of her Wisdom modifier for all monk class features (including AC bonus, ki pool, and saving throw DCs).

Tactical Flurry (Ex)

When using flurry of blows against a foe she has studied for at least 1 round, the war scholar adds her Intelligence bonus on attack rolls. Replaces maneuver training.

Dissect Technique (Ex)

At 4th level, by expending 1 ki point as a swift action, the war scholar identifies a foe’s defensive vulnerabilities, bypassing up to 5 points of the target’s DR for 1 round. Replaces slow fall.
